Game use: thompson
Notes: A 1928-pattern Thompson: finned barrel, Cutts compensator, vertical foregrip and a 50-round L drum (the drum is the Mag part; the game's M1A1 stick mag is a phase-2 choice: hide the drum and build a stick, or keep the drum look). Top-mounted bolt knob is the Bolt part. 12 materials, 1K textures.
